messages.author: 8922bd70d1d35ea2
messages.subject: Boxplot question
parts:
Hi all,
I am a newbie of ggplot2 and I need your help in formatting a boxplot. 
See below the lines I am using to produce the pictured plots.
I’d like to set all the boxplots to the same horizontal size but I am not able to do that.
Can you help me?
Many thanks.
Marco

ggplot(x2, aes(x=DPType, y=Interval, fill=IOI)) + 
geom_boxplot() + 
labs(title="",x="DPtype", y = "Interval (s)") + 
facet_grid(. ~ Sex) +  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2") + theme_minimal() + theme(strip.background = element_rect(colour="white", fill="white”))

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Boxplot question
parts:
This should answer your question:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/16705129/force-boxplots-from-geom-boxplot-to-constant-width

Basically, you're missing combinations of some of your factors, so
need to add some dummy data.

Ben
